Subject: Discovery recap + demo?

Hi Alex —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap from our discovery:  
- Primary use case: low-latency inference for realtime customer support triage (chat + routing).
- Volume: ~20k requests/day, spikes to ~200 req/min during peak.
- Success metrics: 95th pct latency < 300ms, cost target <$0.003/request.
- Constraints: must run in US regions, SOC 2 and customer data retention requirements.

Next step: schedule a technical demo + deep dive with your engineering lead to go over architecture, integrations, and performance numbers.

Can you do one of the following slots next week (PDT)?
- Tue 10/13 10:30–11:15am
- Wed 10/14 1:00–1:45pm

If neither works, send a couple times that do and I’ll tighten confirmation. I also attached a short mutual action plan and my discovery notes.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
